verdict.rationale: Floot has a dedicated self-hosting doc page stating you can export the code and the database and deploy them wherever you like. Other docs back this up: projects are real TypeScript/React apps you can fully export, and a full SQL dump is available on any plan. missing for 10: step-by-step self-hosting instructions (build/runtime requirements, target hosts), guidance on replacing Floot-managed services such as brokered OAuth, email, push and scheduled jobs outside Floot, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an external deployment.
